termsText.footer: By using eTribunal, you acknowledge that you have read and understood these terms. We may update these terms from time to time, and your continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

privacyText.footer: At eTribunal, we believe privacy is a fundamental right. We are committed to being transparent about how we handle your data and giving you control over your information. If you have any questions about this policy, please contact our support team.

guidelinesContent.enforcementText: Violating these guidelines may result in content removal, account suspension, or permanent bans. We rely on the community to report violations and keep eTribunal a fair place for everyone.

rule1.title: No Harassment
rule1.description: eTribunal is for resolving conflicts, not creating them. We have zero tolerance for bullying, hate speech, or targeted harassment. Be firm in your case, but never cruel.

rule2.title: No Personal Data Exposure
rule2.description: Protect the privacy of everyone involved. Do not post real names, addresses, phone numbers, or private social media profiles. Keep evidence focused on the conflict, not the person's identity.

rule3.title: No Fake or Manipulated Content
rule3.description: The community's verdict depends on the truth. Do not post doctored screenshots, deepfakes, or intentionally misleading evidence. Integrity is the foundation of a fair trial.

rule4.title: Respect Others
rule4.description: Even in disagreement, maintain a level of basic human respect. This applies to both the parties in a case and the community members voting on it. Disagree with the actions, not the person.

aboutContent.intro1: eTribunal is a social platform for digital trials where users can share their stories, get unbiased opinions, and participate in community-driven justice. We believe in anonymous discourse and democratic decision-making.
aboutContent.intro2: Whether you're seeking advice, want to vote on disputes, or simply observe, eTribunal provides a safe space for open, honest conversations.

feature1.title: Anonymous Justice
feature1.description: Share your story without fear of judgment. Your identity is protected by design.

feature2.title: Community Driven
feature2.description: A space where the community decides what's fair through democratic voting.

feature3.title: Fair Trials
feature3.description: Every story deserves to be heard. Get unbiased opinions from diverse perspectives.

feature4.title: Real-time Updates
feature4.description: Stay informed with live voting, reactions, and trending cases.

legal.termsSection1Content: By accessing or using eTribunal, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you may not use our services. eTribunal is a platform for social conflict resolution and entertainment purposes.
legal.termsSection2Content: You are solely responsible for the content you post, including stories, evidence, and comments. You agree not to post content that is illegal, harmful, threatening, abusive, harassing, defamatory, vulgar, obscene, or invasive of another's privacy. eTribunal reserves the right to remove any content that violates these guidelines.
legal.termsSection3Content: eTribunal encourages anonymous participation to protect user privacy. However, anonymity does not grant permission to violate community standards. We do not require real names, but we do require respectful interaction. Any attempt to deanonymize other users is strictly prohibited.
legal.termsSection4Content: The 'Verdict' reached by the community is for social and entertainment purposes only. It does not constitute legal advice or a legally binding judgment. eTribunal is not liable for any actions taken by users based on the community's consensus.
legal.termsSection5Content: By posting content on eTribunal, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to use, store, display, and distribute your content for the purpose of operating and improving the platform.
legal.termsSection6Content: eTribunal is provided 'as is' without any warranties. We are not responsible for any disputes, damages, or losses resulting from your use of the platform or interactions with other users.
legal.privacySection1Content: We collect minimal information to operate eTribunal. This includes your email address (for account recovery and security), your chosen anonymous username, and technical data like your IP address and device type. We do not require or collect your real name, physical address, or phone number.
legal.privacySection2Content: Any stories, evidence (images), and comments you post are stored on our secure servers. While we encourage anonymity, please be aware that any information you include in your public posts is visible to other users. We do not use your content for advertising purposes.
legal.privacySection3Content: eTribunal does not sell your personal data to third parties. We only share information when required by law, to protect our rights, or with service providers who help us operate the platform (e.g., cloud storage). Your anonymous profile and posts are shared with the eTribunal community as part of the core app experience.
legal.privacySection4Content: We use industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We encourage you to use a strong, unique password and to avoid sharing sensitive personal details in your public cases.
legal.privacySection5Content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your account information at any time through the Settings menu. If you choose to delete your account, we will remove your personal data from our active databases, though some content (like comments on others' cases) may remain in an anonymized form.
legal.privacySection6Content: We use essential cookies to keep you logged in and to remember your preferences (like Dark Mode). We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising or behavioral profiling.
